content: Postgres backups silently break via stale WAL archiving (archive_command failing while failed_count climbs and last_archived_time goes stale in pg_stat_archiver, unnoticed because nobody monitors it); pg_dump gives a logical, self-consistent snapshot but is schema/version-sensitive and does not capture continuous WAL; pg_basebackup + WAL archiving enables point-in-time recovery; the single decisive practice is to actually run the restore procedure before an emergency, not just to automate the backup.
